description: This file implements the Telemetry functionality for a WPEFramework plugin, including report uploading, privacy mode handling, event dispatching, and configuration management.

classes.name: TelemetryImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing telemetry functionalities, including event handling, configuration, and communication with external systems.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Initializes the telemetry plugin with the service, sets up power management, privacy mode, and report profiles.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for telemetry events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: SetReportProfileStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the report profile, either STARTED or COMPLETE.

methods.name: LogApplicationEvent
methods.description: Logs an application event with a name and value.

methods.name: UploadReport
methods.description: Triggers the upload of a telemetry report via RBus.

methods.name: AbortReport
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing telemetry report upload via RBus.
